# NOKTRA

> Verification tools for air-gapped environments. Nine offline-first desktop instruments for defense, aerospace, industrial and semiconductor test engineering — built to run on air-gapped networks that never touch the internet. No cloud services, no telemetry, no accounts. Any AI runs locally on the engineer's own machine. Philosophy: "Proof, not consensus." — golden-vector suites, deterministic checkers judge, AI only proposes, a human approves.

Site: https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/
GitHub: https://github.com/Kim-Hakseong
Contact: makseong@gmail.com

## Products (five verbs, nine instruments)

### Define
- [ICD Refinery](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/icd-refinery/): Turns messy, inconsistent interface control documents into a validated canonical spec — local-LLM extraction, deterministic linting, human approval, codec generation.

### Run
- [SIL Runtime](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/sil-runtime/): Fixed-step model execution for control software without hardware — deterministic MIL/SIL loops, stimulus injection, limit judgment.
- [Test Sequencer](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/test-sequencer/): YAML test sequences → execution → pass/fail judgment → audit-ready HTML reports.

### Observe
- [Telemetry Scope](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/telemetry-scope/): Channel-defined live strip charts with recording and timed replay — replay a test exactly as it happened.
- [Ch10 Viewer](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/ch10-viewer/): IRIG 106 Chapter 10 flight-test recording viewer — stream GB-class files, survive corruption, export channels.

### Connect
- [Protocol Bridge](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/protocol-bridge/): Unattended channel mapping across Modbus, UDP, serial and MQTT — scale, deadband, reconnect, keep running.
- [SECS/GEM Workbench](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/secsgem-workbench/): Semiconductor equipment↔host protocol decoder and simulator — HSMS sessions, SECS-II trees, host or equipment role.

### Assure
- [RAM Toolkit](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/ram-toolkit/): Reliability prediction, RBD availability and FMECA with audit-grade math trails — every number shows its formula.
- [Local Test Copilot](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/local-test-copilot/): Air-gapped C unit-test generation — a local LLM proposes cases, gcc + gcov judge them, coverage gaps drive the loop.

## Pages
- [Products index](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/products/): every build, every state, one page
- [Method](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/method/): golden vectors, determinism before intelligence, offline as a design constraint, the engineer signs
- [Contact](https://kim-hakseong.github.io/noktra-website/contact/): mailto + GitHub, no forms

## Facts
- All instruments are offline-first; builds ship as single-file executables (Windows 10/11 x64 unless noted; Local Test Copilot is a Linux/macOS CLI).
- Product status is one of: available, beta, in development. In-development tools are listed with no promised dates.
- Golden-vector suites ship inside each build; deterministic checkers issue every verdict; AI output is never labelled pass or fail.
